title: Quaint Flaky German Fish Pilaf
description: A romantic German dish featuring flaky fish and umami flavors, reduced to perfection with Mediterranean-friendly ingredients
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillets with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the white wine, lemon juice, and bouillon cubes to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the basmati rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is coated in the sauce.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, until the fish is flaky and the rice is tender.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
